args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing carriage returns (`\r`) before checking and popping trailing empty lines, so files with Windows line endings (`\r\n`) and a trailing newline do not fail parsing on the empty line past the last row.
args.title: Handle trailing carriage returns when popping empty lines in parser

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Files with Windows line endings (\r\n) leave a trailing \r after splitting by \n, preventing the trailing empty line check from popping the last empty line and causing parser failure on the final row.
